description:
Demand derivation re-ran once per call-chain level: a DeriveRuntimeDemand run
read a callee's answer before that callee had finished deriving it, published
on the strength of it, and was woken again each time the answer moved.
Approved proposal (2026-09-26): artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/YT7S1GcnSwxxRTM3ctW5qR.
Built on fz-afu.2 (PR #243, bf70cf13e).

## What changed
1. One question, one implementation: `World::answer_use(reader, fact)` says how a run
   may use a callee's answer. A partner (its producer's waits reach the reader,
   `World::waits_reach`) is read Current: the two are one fixpoint. A concluded answer
   is read `FactUse::Concluded`. Anything else is waited on at Concluded, and the
   callee is unanswered, never read as bottom. `CalleeAnswers::read` in
   runtime_demand.rs uses it; the `stands_alone`/`waits_on` rules are deleted.
2. `World::pop_runnable` is the one way a job leaves the agenda. A job whose last run
   read a Concluded answer that is being derived again waits for it without running
   (`Scheduler::wait_without_running`) and is woken like any other waiter. Every pop
   site uses it (drive.rs, product_drive.rs).
3. Waiting extends, concluding replaces, for RuntimeDemandInputs too: a blocked run
   joins into the standing answer (`World::extend_runtime_demand_inputs`), a concluding
   run replaces it (`World::conclude_runtime_demand_inputs`). No A->B->A dips.
4. Causal replay: several change records for one key in one completion fold to first
   old vs last new (`record_movements`); wakes whose cause use is concluded replay as
   `Cause::Concluded` (`concluded_caused` in FormulaWork).
5. Send demand and input slots publish as their own derivations on conclusion
   (`DerivationKey::Executable`, `DerivationKey::InputSlot`).

## Measured (pins lowered, each with its cause in a comment)
- Walks cold, range_map / predicate_search / take_drop_split: 237/592/1117 -> 148/477/623.
- fz2_cli runtime_demand_walks: take 1114 -> 620, predicate 589 -> 474, range_map 234 -> 145.
- work_start_reason: (937, 705, [58,0,165,482,0]) -> (563, 331, [24,0,79,228,0]).
- 00181 FormulaWork: DeriveRuntimeDemand runs 37 -> 29, wakes into it 36 -> 13.
- AnalyzeActivation zero-change pins reclassified by conclusion flips: 9->3, 3->1, 16->7.

## Moved out
"DeriveInputDemand composes from callee InputDemand" (part 2 of the original
description) is fz-afu.10. The call-graph-component design proposed here for it is
unsound: a protocol callback is a static-graph leaf but forwards to every
implementation, so a forwarding cycle through it is invisible to CallGraphComponent.

## Gate
lib 2242 passed, 2 failed -- compiler2_contracts (00548-00552) and
compiler2_tuple_return_ladder_revises_once_per_nesting_level, red on develop since
d91cae495 and owned by fz-xxd.3. fixture_matrix 828, fz2_cli 33, doc tests green.
title: Demand answers are read once they have concluded
